entry.title: Chancellor May & Jesse Salinas Encourage Students to Vote

media:group.media:title: Chancellor May & Jesse Salinas Encourage Students to Vote
media:group.media:description:
Hi, Aggies! It’s Chancellor May, and I’m with Jesse Salinas, the Yolo County Registrar of Voters, to encourage you to register to vote! 🗳️
Election Day is coming up fast! The deadline to register for the upcoming election on Tuesday, November 3rd, is Monday, October 19th.
Your voice matters. Your vote matters. Aggies, get out to vote! 💙💛
To register to vote, visit registertovote.ca.gov, and to check voter registration status, visit voterstatus.sos.ca.gov. You can click the link in my bio to do both.

entry.title: Setting Olive Oil Standards with UC Davis Research

media:group.media:title: Setting Olive Oil Standards with UC Davis Research
media:group.media:description:
What makes California olive oil worth a closer look? Mary Mori of California Olive Ranch explains how UC Davis Olive Center research helped California producers gain global attention and challenged the quality of imported olive oils.
A major 2010 study raised questions about whether the olive oil on store shelves lived up to its label. Mori shares what that research meant for California’s olive oil industry. She also explains how federally funded research helps reveal the chemistry of California olive oils and demonstrate their quality.
This video is part of From Labs to Lives, a UC Davis series showing how research shapes everyday life.
Learn more at https://ucdav.is/UCDOilResearch
Video description: Mary Mori, Vice President of Quality and Product at California Olive Ranch, speaks to the camera with a mix of b-roll of olive trees, olives and olive oil shown throughout the video.

entry.title: Alumni Engagement and Leadership at UC Davis | Face to Face with Chancellor May

media:group.media:title: Alumni Engagement and Leadership at UC Davis | Face to Face with Chancellor May
media:group.media:description:
In this episode of Face to Face with Chancellor May, UC Davis alumna Deborah Austin, a healthcare executive and president of CAAA (Cal Aggie Alumni Association) board, reflects on her journey from UC Davis student to alumni leader. She discusses the value of mentors and experiences that shaped her student experience and career path, along with her commitment to strengthening alumni engagement and mentorship. She also shares her family’s deep connection to UC Davis and her vision for helping future generations of Aggies build meaningful networks, access resources and stay connected to the university.
1:07 What inspired Deborah to lead the CAAA and her involvement with UC Davis 2:06 Importance of alumni networks 3:23 Value of mentors and the legacy Deborah hopes to create for future Aggies 6:06 Shares her husband’s story as a UC Davis student, football player and first-generation graduate 9:29 Student work and undergraduate internships and their influence on her career in healthcare administration 11:26 Advice to current students about staying involved, finding networks and using campus resources 14:22 Hot Seat questions: public speaking, graduating UC Davis as an accomplishment and best advice ever received 16:30 Question to Chancellor: how can UC Davis alumni support the university 17:40 How can alumni network support the UC system and UC Davis
*About From Labs to Lives* In our From Labs to Lives series, UC Davis researchers describe the impact of their work and the consequences if federal funding for medical research were reduced or eliminated. Our research strengthens the U.S. economy and drives innovation in science and medicine. By finding new treatments and preventing illness, our work saves lives. More at: https://www.ucdavis.edu/research/labs-to-lives?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=chancellor_fltl
*About UC Davis Chancellor Gary S. May* Gary S. May became UC Davis’ seventh chancellor on Aug. 1, 2017. An accomplished scholar and engineer, May came to UC Davis from the Georgia Institute of Technology. More at: https://leadership.ucdavis.edu/chancellor/gary-s-may?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=chancellor_fltl
*Follow Chancellor May* Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/chancellormay.bsky.social Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/ChancellorMay/ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/chancellor.may/ Twitter/X: https://x.com/chancellor_may
*All UC Davis Podcasts and Shows* https://www.ucdavis.edu/news/podcasts-and-shows?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=chancellor_fltl
*Check Out UC Davis* Website: https://www.ucdavis.edu/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=chancellor_fltl Virtual campus tour: https://www.ucdavis.edu/about/visit/campus-virtual-tour/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=chancellor_fltl
*About UC Davis* Since the beginning, we’ve outgrown expectations. Established in 1908 as a university farm, UC Davis has continually branched out, challenged the way things are done, and gained recognition for solving complex problems related to health, environment, culture and society. Our 5,300-acre campus borders the city of Davis, a vibrant college town of about 68,000 people in Yolo County. UC Davis is among the most comprehensive campuses in the University of California system, with four colleges and six professional schools that offer over 100 undergraduate majors and more than 100 graduate and professional degrees. UC Davis enrolls about 40,000 students from over 110 countries and contributes at least $13 billion to the California economy each year. In the 2024-25 fiscal year, the university exceeded $1 billion in research funding for the third consecutive year, cementing its reputation as a tier one research university.
